notes: Runtime-gate anchors are intentionally conservative and cover more than one subsystem. Offline qualification also reports optional signatures that are useful for diagnosing a new build without making them hard requirements for normal startup.

anchors.name: Lua dummynode
anchors.reason: EXU's statically linked Lua core hard-codes the executable's dummynode address (Lua5.1-BZR/src/ltable.c). luaopen_exu checks this anchor before creating any table and refuses to load when it fails.

anchors.name: Wingman Hunt activation
anchors.reason: Unique, independently validated 2.2.301 gameplay anchor outside the UI subsystem; prevents the overlay wrappers alone from becoming the entire global native-patch gate.
